source: Recorded from a live Mailchimp account on 2026-10-17: one webhook created on an audience for campaign events only, pointed at a capture server, then deleted. Audience and webhook IDs are replaced with test placeholders, the URL with {{url}}, and the signing secret (43 characters, returned only in the create response) with {{signing_secret}}. Before answering the create request, Mailchimp checked the URL with the GET recorded under validation.
